name: Pigeon Post
summary: Write a note and a carrier pigeon flies it across dusk rooftops to the friend you pick
about: A note composer set on a rooftop at dusk. Your note rolls up onto the pigeon's leg, it crouches, takes off with fast wing beats, glides over the skyline and lands on your friend's roof, where the note pops up as read. Friends further away get a longer flight and a smaller pigeon, and it always flies home after.
how: Pick who it is for: Zara, Hamid or Sana, each on a roof at a different distance.
Write a short note (up to 80 characters); Ctrl or Cmd + Enter sends it too.
Press Send by pigeon: the note rolls onto its leg and the button fills as it flies.
On landing the note pops up over your friend's roof, then the pigeon flies home.
An empty note makes the field shake and the pigeon shake its head.
